answer: Mechanism: Operator Quota Fusion. Each operator’s infrastructure fingerprint—ASN, host keys, billing entity—shares one cedar-logged quota across all its wallets. Crossing a sybil threshold freezes the operator’s registration keys and API egress, not wallet funds. To continue, the operator must forge new hosting and billing identities; repeated flags trigger a fable audit. Attacker cost: lost cloud contracts, forced key rotation, and manual audit per operator.
